newsitem.title: USA: Footstar "optimistic" on Q4 profit outlook.
newsitem.headline: Footstar "optimistic" on Q4 profit outlook.

text.p: Footstar Inc on Thursday said it was "optmistic" about fourth quarter profits, due to strong sales in October and November.

"In light of the October and November sales strength, we are increasingly optimistic in our outlook for fourth quarter profits," Mickey Robinson, Footstar's chairman and chief executive, said in a statement.
"November's sales exceeded our expectations in both chains," he added, refering to Footstar's Footaction and Meldisco retail footwear chains.
The company said Footaction's November comparable store sales increased 8.5 percent from the year-ago period, while Meldisco's comparable store sales increased 4.8 percent. --
